query_text: I cannot log in; the system says my password is incorrect.
expected_resolution_pattern: reset credentials; verify account lock state; check sign-in factors
notes: Account-access guidance should focus on restoring access, not generic advice.

query_text: I was charged twice for my subscription this month.
expected_resolution_pattern: review billing history; adjust invoice or refund; confirm plan and subscription state
notes: Billing guidance should stay in refund/invoice territory.

query_text: I am seeing an error message when I click on analytics dashboard.
expected_resolution_pattern: reproduce the bug; inspect logs; deploy or verify a fix
notes: RAG should ground in bug-resolution history, not security or billing cases.

query_text: The api integration feature is not saving my changes.
expected_resolution_pattern: reproduce save failure; inspect integration logs; patch the defect
notes: Expected answer should be concrete product-debug guidance.

query_text: Queries in the analytics dashboard module are timing out.
expected_resolution_pattern: investigate slow queries; increase resources; verify timeout thresholds
notes: Performance incidents should map to optimization / scaling steps.

query_text: There seems to be a vulnerability in the analytics dashboard functionality.
expected_resolution_pattern: investigate logs; mitigate exposure; update security settings; escalate if needed
notes: Security answers should mention mitigation and escalation clearly.

query_text: Can you explain how to configure analytics dashboard properly?
expected_resolution_pattern: provide setup steps; point to documentation; confirm expected configuration
notes: How-to requests should not get bug-fix style answers.

query_text: Can you add an option to customize analytics dashboard?
expected_resolution_pattern: capture request; note product backlog; avoid pretending there is an immediate fix
notes: Feature requests should be summarized as backlog/product feedback, not troubleshooting.
